arguments.command:
set -eu
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
cp backup.sh "$tmp/backup.sh"
mkdir -p "$tmp/logs" "$tmp/bin"
printf 'entry\n' > "$tmp/logs/app.log"
cat > "$tmp/bin/tar" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
printf '%s\n' "$*" >> "$CALL_LOG"
: > "$3"
EOF
cat > "$tmp/bin/scp" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
printf '%s\n' "$*" >> "$CALL_LOG"
EOF
chmod +x "$tmp/bin/tar" "$tmp/bin/scp"
(
  cd "$tmp"
  CALL_LOG="$tmp/calls" PATH="$tmp/bin:$PATH" ./backup.sh > output
)
stamp=$(date +%Y%m%d)
test "$(sed -n '1p' "$tmp/calls")" = "-czf logs-$stamp.tar.gz logs/"
test "$(sed -n '2p' "$tmp/calls")" = "logs-$stamp.tar.gz backup-srv:/srv/nightly/"
grep -F "wrote logs-$stamp.tar.gz and copied it to backup-srv:/srv/nightly/" "$tmp/output"
printf '%s\n' 'backup.sh syntax and mocked tar/scp integration test passed'
